claims.text: The medieval churches of Lalibela in Ethiopia were carved out of solid rock.
The Lalibela churches were not built of mud brick, framed in cedar or clad in marble.
The Lalibela churches were carved downward into volcanic rock, and several stand free within trenches.
The Church of St George (Bete Giyorgis) at Lalibela is cross-shaped in plan.
